title: Replace hero image with uploaded herbs & spices photo and Ken Burns animation with Nature Glow name overlay

requirements.text: Save the uploaded herbs and spices image (mortar & pestle with turmeric, ginger, rosemary, garlic, cinnamon on a wooden table) as the hero background image at frontend/public/assets/generated/hero-herbs-spices.dim_1920x1080.jpg and use it as the Ken Burns animated background in the Hero component, replacing any previously used hero image.

quotes: Use this image into image and use this image
ken burn effect of this image same project

acceptanceCriteria: The uploaded herbs and spices photo is rendered as the full-screen hero background in Hero.tsx
The previous hero background image is replaced by this new image

requirements.text: Apply a Ken Burns CSS animation (smooth continuous slow pan and zoom) to the hero background image in the Hero component, so the herbs and spices image gently moves across the viewport in a cinematic loop.

quotes: Like a ken burn effect of this image
make sure nature glow which name of the website is visible on hero moving image

acceptanceCriteria: The hero background image continuously pans and zooms in a slow, smooth loop (Ken Burns effect)
The animation loops seamlessly without jarring cuts
The Ken Burns keyframe animation in tailwind.config.js is used or updated to power this effect

requirements.text: Display the 'Nature Glow' website name prominently as an overlay text on the hero section, positioned so it is clearly visible over the Ken Burns animated herbs and spices background. Style it with a large, elegant serif font (Playfair Display), white or cream color with a subtle text shadow, so it remains legible as the image moves beneath it.

quotes: make sure nature glow which name of the website is visible on hero moving image
Nature Glow is the name of the website

acceptanceCriteria: The text 'Nature Glow' is visible and prominent on the hero section over the animated background
The text does not scroll with the background image — it remains fixed in position within the hero overlay
The text uses Playfair Display font and is styled to match the natural/Ayurvedic aesthetic
The text remains legible regardless of which part of the image is currently panned into view

constraints: Do not modify files in frontend/src/hooks/useInternetIdentity.ts, frontend/src/hooks/useActor.ts, frontend/src/main.tsx, or frontend/src/components/ui
Keep all other existing sections of the site (Navbar, FeaturedProducts, Benefits, Testimonials, AboutAyurveda, Footer) unchanged
Only the Hero component and its associated image asset should change
nonGoals: Converting the image to an actual animated GIF file
Adding new pages or product catalog changes
Modifying backend logic or data models

edits: Crop and optimize the uploaded herbs and spices flat-lay photo showing a mortar and pestle with turmeric, ginger, rosemary, garlic, cinnamon, and lemon on a wooden table, suitable for a full-screen hero background (hero-herbs-spices.dim_1920x1080.jpg)
